desc: An application log covers 09:00 to 17:00. Work out which hour contains the most ERROR lines and name that hour.
A service started returning 502s at 14:15. Given the log around that time, say which downstream component failed first and what the evidence is.
A deposit of 3,200,000 KRW earns 4.2% annual interest compounded monthly. Work out the balance after 18 months.
Given the response times 120, 95, 430, 88, 102, 76 and 2100 milliseconds, work out the median and explain why the mean is misleading here.
Cut a four-paragraph release note down to a single sentence a customer would understand, keeping what changed and what they must do.
Rewrite a blunt email to a client so it stays direct but no longer reads as rude, without adding any new commitments.
